subject: Request: 72-hour sandbox runway while PO clears finance queue
messages:
From: Emily Wu <emily.wu@medivance.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-30T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial access for Medivance — procurement update

Hi Vivek,

Quick update from procurement: the PO has been created but finance put it into a queue for an extra review. They estimate clearance in 4-6 business days. Our pilot team is worried about the sandbox drying up before the review completes. Is there any short-term option to keep the environment alive for the team — even a 72-hour runway or a small token top-up while the PO clears? We need to continue the integration tests to keep momentum.

I can provide the PO draft and the contact at finance if that helps. Appreciate any temporary leeway.

Best,
Emily
Emily Wu
Head of Clinical Integrations, Medivance
emily.wu@medivance.com

Attachments: medivance_po_draft.pdf (application/pdf, 142KB)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Emily Wu <emily.wu@medivance.com>
Cc: soojin_lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-30T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial access for Medivance — procurement update

Hi Emily,

Thanks for the quick note and for attaching the PO draft. I understand the urgency — losing momentum now would slow the integration a lot. We can usually approve short runway extensions in cases where the PO is in-flight and procurement confirms the intent.

Would a 72-hour sandbox runway and a modest token top-up (equivalent to our small pilot tier) be sufficient for the team to finish integration smoke tests? If so, I will start an approval with CS and Sales Ops. I will need the PO contact and an ETA from finance if you have it.

I will keep this tight and get back within the hour after checking with the team.

Regards,
Vivek
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: soojin_lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-30T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Trial access for Medivance — procurement update

Team,

Medivance (deal RDW-2027-1337) has a PO in finance but engineers will run out of sandbox tokens in ~48 hours. Customer asked for a 72-hour runway plus a small top-up to complete integration verification. PO draft attached.

Ask: can CS approve a 72-hour sandbox extension and issue a small pilot top-up tied to the PO (no permanent credit, will be reconciled when PO clears)? If we can, I will confirm with Emily and include the conditional note that credits are contingent on PO finalization within 10 business days.

Why: preserves momentum, increases chance of a smooth production onboarding, and reduces churn risk.

Please reply with approve/decline and any constraints. If approved, can someone generate the sandbox-credit-approval notice and include the PO reference?

Thanks,
Vivek

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, soojin_lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-30T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Trial access for Medivance — procurement update

Approve.

We can grant a 72-hour sandbox runway and issue a 3-day pilot top-up equivalent to the small pilot tier. Conditions:
- Credits explicitly conditional on PO finalization within 10 business days.
- Finance reference must be included in the ticket (Procurement contact or PO number).
- CS will attach a sandbox-credit-approval.pdf and a short usage summary to the HubSpot deal record.

Soojin, can you please generate the approval notice and update HubSpot with the PO draft link? I will notify Finance that this is a one-off, conditional extension.

Neha
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: sandbox_credit_notice.pdf

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Emily Wu <emily.wu@medivance.com>
Cc: soojin_lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-02T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial access for Medivance — procurement update

Hi Emily,

Good news — we approved a short runway. Redwood will apply a 72-hour sandbox extension and a small pilot token top-up to keep your integration tests running. This is a conditional, one-time accommodation tied to the PO in flight: please confirm the finance contact or PO number within 48 hours so we can reconcile when the PO clears.

Attached is the sandbox-credit-approval.pdf with the conditions and the usage cap. We noted the HubSpot deal RDW-2027-1337 and linked your PO draft.

If anything changes on your side, ping me directly. Glad we can keep the trial moving.

Best,
Vivek
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: sandbox-credit-approval.pdf (application/pdf, 28KB)
